notes.page_content: The manuscript sets out the assertion that the closure of V misses E_beta for beta in I setminus K, then states a lemma about an E_i contained in a union of the written Sigma-alpha-plus sets. It follows with a corollary describing the written partition Pi_K with its ring/zero exponent. The last line attributes the result to induction on card K >= 0. These are the manuscript's assertions, recorded without a proof check.
